'''Chammian ivory''' was a type of [[Ivory (substance)|ivory]]<ref name="TCWnovel" /> from<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Chamm system/Legends|Chamm system]].<ref name="TEA" /> At one point, a wall [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]] was made from Chammian ivory, and at some point<ref name="TCWnovel" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> when the timepiece was an antique, it ended up in the possession of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], who displayed it in the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] room of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his palace]] on<ref name="TCWnovel" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Jabba, however, could not recall whether he had obtained the chronometer by way of a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] debt being settled with him or from a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who had failed to deliver a contract on [[Time/Legends|time]] and had only been given a beating instead of being [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TCWnovel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chammian ivory was introduced in [[Karen Traviss]]'<ref name="TCWnovel" /> [[July 26]], [[2008]]<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of<ref name="TCWnovel" /> the [[August 15]], 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|film]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' multimedia project]].<ref name="YearByYear" />
